decisive_items: Physical examination revealed dozens of skin-colored dome-shaped papules over the chin, nasal, and perinasal regions of the face
Dental examination showed several teeth with a conical shape
response.rationale: The presence of angiofibromas and conical teeth are characteristic features of TSC, making it a more likely diagnosis than MEN1 associated angiofibromas

rejected.why: Absence of characteristic skin lesions makes this diagnosis less likely
Absence of hypopigmented macules makes this diagnosis less likely
